description: Header file defining utility functions and enums for parsing numbers in network protocols, including functions for parsing integers with various formats and error handling.

classes.name: ParseIntFormat
classes.description: Enumeration specifying formats for parsing integers, such as non-negative, optionally negative, and strict variants.

classes.name: ParseIntError
classes.description: Enumeration indicating reasons for failure in parsing integers, including overflow, underflow, and parse errors.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit integer according to specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseInt64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit integer according to specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit unsigned integer according to specified format, returning success status and error details.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit unsigned integer according to specified format, returning success status and error details.
